ADVANCED ORTHOPAEDICS & SPORTS MEDICINE – A FULL-SERVICE ORTHOPEDIC PRACTICE IN HOUSTON, TX, PROVIDING TREATMENT FOR INJURIES OF THE KNEE, HIP, SHOULDER, NECK, SPINE, ELBOW, WRIST, HAND, FOOT, AND ANKLE

Consulting an orthopedic surgeon, pain management specialist, rheumatologist, physical therapist or occupational hand therapist is simple at Advanced Orthopaedics & Sports Medicine of Houston, Texas. Our patients have access to a full team of compassionate, board-certified and double-board-certified medical professionals under one roof, and each individual receives a comprehensive treatment plan that’s tailored to his or her specific needs. We are committed to providing our patients with the treatments they need to get back to their busy lives, as well as the education they need to feel comfortable.

Since 1983, we have provided the latest treatments for conditions affecting the knee, hip, shoulder, spine, foot, ankle, hand, wrist and elbow. We host 40+ providers and 4 locations.
